architecture.summary: Scripts and documents only: the fleet script script/fleet/fleet.ts opens the tenant registry with the bounds of an operator far from the pooler. script/fleet/fleet-context.ts passes the constant REGISTRY_BOUNDS (acquisition 15 s, operation 15 s, statement 10 s, close 5 s, the values of the rehearsal reads of script/release/rehearsal/rehearsal-db.ts) to createPgSettingsRuntime in place of the defaults of src/runtime/sql/bounded-sql-runtime.ts (acquisition 1 s, operation 2 s, statement 1.5 s, close 1.5 s). From the owner's Mac the TLS connection to the production pooler alone takes about 1 s (2 November 2026), so a read with the defaults ended with 'The tenant registry cannot be read. Nothing changed.' The runtime module, its defaults, and the control plane do not change: no file under src/ changes. script/README.md (Operate the tenant fleet) states the bounds and the reason, and docs/implementation/tenant-fleet-runbooks.md adds one sentence to the definition of fleet.ts; both replace the sentence of #330 that named this follow-up (a configurable bound) and keep its link to the finding of SO-12 step 11. No test, configuration, workflow, migration, or Mermaid block changes. The production architecture is unchanged: the operator CLI keeps its composition of the tenants, render, and workos owners and its registry relationship, which architecture/components.md draws without bounds.
